findings.title: Fallback and explicit `:locale` translations are not loaded outside `ApplicationController#set_locale` or after `I18n.reload!`
findings.body:
`I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only invoked in `ApplicationController#set_locale`, while `I18n.translate` in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` still only runs `load_locale(config.locale)`. Because `translate_accelerator.rb` overrides `I18n::Backend::Base#load_translations` to prevent automatic loading, `I18n.backend` only contains translations for locales explicitly passed to `load_locale`. Consequently:
1. Any translation call outside a controller request (such as in Sidekiq background jobs, `UserNotifications` mailers, rake tasks, or specs) or after `I18n.reload!` is called will only load `config.locale` and leave the fallback locales (`SiteSetting.default_locale` and `:en`) unloaded. Fallback lookups will fail with `"translation missing"` and cache the missing-translation string in `@cache`.
2. Calling `I18n.t(key, locale: other_locale)` when `other_locale` has not yet been loaded will not load `other_locale` at all; with `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` enabled, it will silently return the `:en` / `SiteSetting.default_locale` fallback even when a translation exists for `other_locale`.

findings.title: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` does not normalize `locale` to a symbol
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` builds `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` without converting `locale` to a symbol. When `locale` is passed as a `String` (for example via `I18n.t(key, locale: "en")` or `I18n.fallbacks["en"]`), `.uniq` will not deduplicate `"en"` against `:en` (returning `["en", :en]`), and `I18n.load_locale` will not match `"en"` against `:en` in `@loaded_locales`, causing all YAML files for that locale to be parsed and loaded a second time.

findings.title: Missing specs for server-side locale fallbacks
findings.body: This PR introduces custom server-side locale fallback ordering (`[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`) and lazy fallback loading via `FallbackLocaleList`, but adds no specs verifying fallback lookup behavior, pluralization fallback behavior, or lazy loading of fallback locales.
